name: wordmark end card with CTA and fine print
looks: On a plain light field, the bold wordmark settles large and centred, a two-line tagline (the second in italic) fading in beneath it, then a dark rounded CTA button with the destination, and a thin line of fine print under everything.
build: wordmark-assemble's settle stage: the wordmark fades and rises into place, the tagline reveals a beat after, the CTA button scales in from 0.92 on back.out, the fine print fading in last and smallest.
sound: A soft resolving chime as the wordmark settles, a quiet click on the CTA.
prompt: Close on a bold wordmark settling large and centred on a plain field, with a two-line tagline beneath it, its second line in italic. Bring in a dark rounded call-to-action button with the destination a beat later, and a thin line of fine print (trial terms, compatibility) under everything as the final frame.
